title: Senior Product Manager — Generative AI Security
jd_excerpt:
Google LLC in California, San Bruno, is seeking a Product Manager for YouTube AI Safety to guide AI security features from conception to launch, collaborating with Engineering, Research, and cross-functional teams to build secure AI-powered YouTube experiences.

You will define risk principles, advocate threat modeling, and drive metrics. The role emphasizes partnering with executives and developers to deliver secure, scalable protections while aligning with Google's culture of innovation.
